- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on the 23 likes on your Facebook post! That's exciting!
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for making a moist vegan chocolate cake:
  1. Use a combination of sugar and natural sweeteners.
  2. Choose the right non-dairy milk (high in fat content).
  3. Use high-quality cocoa powder (Dutch-processed).
  4. Don't overmix the batter.
  5. Use a lower oven temperature (around 325°F/165°C).
  6. Add an extra moisture source (mashed banana, applesauce, or silken tofu).
  7. Don't overbake.
  8. Use a flax egg or aquafaba.
  9. Add some extra fat (vegan butter or oil).
  10. Store the cake properly in an airtight container.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ask if the user has a specific recipe in mind or if they would like recommendations.
